user.title: WG Easy
user.description: Step 1 of 2: enter the server address (e.g. https://host or https://host/subpath - just the base address, no need to add any API path) and API version. The URL/version will be checked (without any credentials yet) before you're asked for a password or token.

data_description.verify_ssl: Leave on unless your wg-easy server uses a self-signed certificate you trust. Turning this off skips certificate validation - only use it on a trusted network.

credentials.title: WG Easy – credentials
credentials.description: Step 2 of 3: detected/selected API version: {api_version}. (v14 users: no further steps after this.)

data_description.token: The Bearer Password set under Admin Panel → General → Metrics in the wg-easy web UI. This integration automatically appends /metrics/json to your server address to reach it.
data_description.password: The same password you use to log in to the wg-easy web UI (set via the PASSWORD_HASH environment variable on the wg-easy container).

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure WG Easy
reconfigure.description: Step 1 of 2: update the server address and/or API version.

data_description.verify_ssl: Leave on unless your wg-easy server uses a self-signed certificate you trust. Turning this off skips certificate validation - only use it on a trusted network.

data_description.token: The Bearer Password set under Admin Panel → General → Metrics in the wg-easy web UI. This integration automatically appends /metrics/json to your server address to reach it.
data_description.password: The same password you use to log in to the wg-easy web UI (set via the PASSWORD_HASH environment variable on the wg-easy container).

v15_admin.title: WG Easy – admin credentials (optional)
v15_admin.description: Step 3 of 3 (v15 only, optional): provide your wg-easy admin username and password to enable the per-client enable/disable switch. Leave the password blank to skip this step — the switch entities will be created but will show as unavailable until credentials are added via Reconfigure.

data_description.v15_username: The username you log in with in the wg-easy web UI. Defaults to 'admin'.
data_description.v15_admin_password: Your wg-easy login password. Leave blank to skip — switches will be unavailable until credentials are configured.

reconfigure_v15_admin.title: Reconfigure WG Easy – admin credentials (optional)
reconfigure_v15_admin.description: Step 3 of 3 (v15 only, optional): update your wg-easy admin credentials for the enable/disable switch. Leave the password blank to clear saved credentials and make switches unavailable.

data_description.v15_username: The username you log in with in the wg-easy web UI. Defaults to 'admin'.
data_description.v15_admin_password: Your wg-easy login password. Leave blank to clear credentials.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach this address. Check that the URL is correct, the server is running and reachable from Home Assistant (no firewall/VPN in the way), and that the SSL verification setting matches your certificate (turn it off only for a trusted self-signed certificate).
error.not_wg_easy: This address answered, but it doesn't look like a wg-easy server. Double-check the URL, or pick the API version manually instead of auto if you're sure it's correct.
error.invalid_auth: The token/password was rejected by the server. Double-check it (Admin Panel → General → Metrics for the v15 token, or your login password for v14) and try again.

abort.wrong_account: The provided URL does not match this configured instance.
